headlines.title: Why Is Netflix Growing Fastest And Falling Furthest?
headlines.summary: Netflix (NFLX) grew revenue faster over the past twelve months than Amazon, Apple, Comcast, or Disney and earned a wider operating margin than all of them except Apple. Its shares still finished those twelve months down 38.9%, the last of the five. The fall has not made the stock cheap. That is the mismatch worth explaining.

headlines.title: Netflix Now: Welcome To Theatrical Movieland - For Real?
headlines.summary: Netflix will report box-office revenue for six upcoming theatrical movies, as well as seeing much longer theatrical runs than its typical theatrical releases in the past.

headlines.title: Florida Accuses Netflix Of Privacy 'Bait-And-Switch'
headlines.summary: "Netflix's years-long bait-and-switch has led the company right to where it promised never to be: addicting children and families to its platform, mining those users for data, and then converting that data into lucrative intelligence for global advertising juggernauts," Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier alleges.

headlines.title: Is Netflix a Good Buy? After 10 Years of Covering NFLX, Here's My Honest Answer.
headlines.summary: The streaming media giant's pullback could be a buying opportunity.

headlines.title: Grab Netflix Stock Now With Both Hands
headlines.summary: Netflix stock has come off its recent highs, and the dip looks like a good opportunity to add more shares.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
